say:10:1029788008:1.text: No need to be modest. It's because you've awakened and resumed your journey that all of this is happening.

say:11:1029788009:1.text: At this moment, people from across the realm are coming here to celebrate.
say:11:1029788009:1.source_cn: 此时此刻，才会有这么多的人齐聚此处，共同庆祝。

say:12:1029788010:1.text: And what's this magical tree? Its brilliance is simply mesmerizing...
say:12:1029788010:1.source_cn: 这神奇的树又是什么？它的光彩实在让人难以移开视线……
